price.quote: The 2024 Surly Big Easy comes in three sizes (small, medium, and large), weighs in at 74 pounds (size medium), and is only offered as a complete build for $5,499 USD. Head over to SurlyBikes.com or stop by your local Surly dealer to learn more. ⟶ FURTHER READING

cls.quote: It’s a Class 1 e-bike, meaning it is pedal-assist only, with no throttle, and has a maximum assisted speed of 20 miles per hour. It comes as a complete build with a Bosch PowerPack 725Wh battery, Bosch 4A Charger, and a 9-speed Shimano Cues drivetrain. It has a gross payload of 400 pounds total (including rider and cargo).
